changes.reason: The deferral's premise (no bounded weight-experiment outcome existed yet) no longer holds: the deferred experiment was executed as candidate improvement-32116212de9a and returned a sealed complete comparison showing every physical metric worsened against the baseline (terminal error +0.002968421337034852 m, holding max error +0.0053056960894252575 m, holding max speed +0.08785560169753603 m/s) with no deadline-miss change, classified physical_pareto_worsening. The deferral is therefore superseded, not retained as a standing recommendation.

The named coverage gaps persist in this revision: both profiles report selected final-window rows and sampled motion only (not whole-trajectory ranges), and historical warm plans/optimizer iteration traces remain not retained (control_snapshots.json retained=false). No new coverage was obtained here, so extending coverage before interpreting settling still stands.

new_facts.statement: Candidate reach outcome, recorded arithmetic: candidate terminal_error_m = 0.010611029922902238 m (F495) exceeds the 0.01 m tolerance, with candidate terminal_reach_passed = false (F43) and official_reach_task_success = false (F383); candidate-minus-baseline terminal_error_m = +0.002968421337034852 m (F1066) against baseline terminal_error_m 0.007642608585867386 m (F620), which passed. Candidate valid_complete_execution = true (F252). Reported as recorded values only; no causal interpretation.

Candidate holding-position outcome, recorded arithmetic: candidate holding_max_error_m = 0.06344380037515782 m (F98) with holding_position_passed = false (F306); candidate-minus-baseline holding_max_error_m = +0.0053056960894252575 m (F378) against baseline holding_max_error_m 0.05813810428573256 m (F189), which was itself above the 0.01 m limit and failing (F867). Reported separately from holding speed and from terminal reach.

Candidate holding-speed outcome, recorded arithmetic: candidate holding_max_speed_m_s = 1.6688708756718167 m/s (F128) with holding_speed_passed = false (F1050); candidate-minus-baseline holding_max_speed_m_s = +0.08785560169753603 m/s (F595) against baseline holding_max_speed_m_s 1.5810152739742807 m/s (F237), both far above the 0.02 m/s settling speed limit (F62). Reported as a distinct criterion from holding position and terminal reach.

Candidate computation outcome, recorded arithmetic with its own coverage: candidate mean_complete_update_s = 17.515148580027745 s (F136) versus baseline 17.26331904856488 s (F137), a candidate-minus-baseline change of +0.2518295314628638 s (F991); deadline_misses changed by 0 (F1025), 35 misses in both runs (F25, F726) over 35 control updates each (F836, F1064). Mean update time is not described as settling error and wall overruns are not described as skipped simulated updates (F1028).

Sealed campaign comparison classifies the candidate against the baseline as physical_pareto_worsening (F134): the three physical metrics changed as recorded (terminal error F1066, holding max error F378, holding max speed F595), and the ranking rule treats any physical improvement accompanied by physical worsening as a trade-off, never overall improvement (F323), with joint acceptance evaluated first and physical comparison only as fallback (F770). This is derived arithmetic, not a causal certification (F516).

new_limitations: Derived arithmetic from sealed complete evaluations/profiles; source agreement does not certify scientific prose, and citation validity does not establish causality.

Baseline and candidate are distinct executions with different initialization selection (baseline initialization_selected 29 vs candidate 30, F997/F918), so candidate-minus-baseline differences are reported as recorded arithmetic under that confound, not as attributed causes.

No closed-loop counterfactual replay, full backend replay, or retained warm plans/iteration traces are available; physical_pareto_worsening is a componentwise physical comparison, not an explanation of the settling failure or of the deadline misses.
Only selected holding-window rows and sampled motion are reported for both runs; whole-trajectory ranges and unread endpoints remain outside the cited coverage.
arguments.rationale: The revision resolves the two previously deferred diagnostic recommendations against the now-sealed candidate comparison. The bounded weight experiment that rec-defer-weight-experiment had deferred was executed; its outcome worsens all three ranking physical metrics (terminal error +0.002968421337034852 m, holding max error +0.0053056960894252575 m, holding max speed +0.08785560169753603 m/s) with zero deadline-miss change, so the deferral is rejected and the change is not adopted, which is a recommendation disposition decision kept separate from the controller-candidate selection. rec-defer-until-coverage is retained because the cited coverage limits (selected final-window rows, sampled motion, warm plans not retained) are unchanged. All four outcome dimensions are stated separately with their own units and coverage: reach (candidate terminal reach now fails at 0.0106 m), holding position (0.0634 m, worse than baseline 0.0581 m), holding speed (1.669 m/s, worse than baseline 1.581 m/s), and computation (+0.252 s mean update, missing all 35 deadlines in both runs). No causal or dominance claim is made from these single-execution comparisons.
arguments.recommendation: Do not adopt candidate improvement-32116212de9a and retain the baseline controller candidate (baseline-replay, configuration af649bf56cf8642bb85090227ec5390398aff23a96686f972933e24715ba8fd0, execution cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef): the candidate worsened terminal reach (0.010611029922902238 m > 0.01 m tolerance; reach now failing, F495/F43), holding-window position (0.06344380037515782 m, F98) and holding-window speed (1.6688708756718167 m/s, F128), with no reduction in the 35 deadline misses (F1025) and only slightly higher mean update time (17.515148580027745 s, F136), i.e. a physical_pareto_worsening outcome that fails joint acceptance (F134/F770). Treat rec-defer-until-coverage as still open and pursue further coverage/analysis separately from any controller-weight change.
